fields.question: The owner cuts v0.1.0 by hand once the release manifest lands (the owner picked 'By hand after A'), so no leaf cuts it and no builder can verify a real attestation. After the owner pushes the v0.1.0 tag, who runs gh attestation verify on one of its archives and records it as Evidence on release-provenance, closing m33-release-channel's 'v0.1.0 is published' promise: the owner, or the orchestrator when it sees the tag?
fields.statement: The orchestrator cuts v0.1.0 once the manifest-and-provenance change set lands, then runs gh attestation verify on one of its archives and records the Evidence on @{01M76B7CPZ26NZ03MPCK9S55PA}
fields.wording: Orchestrator cuts and verifies: once the manifest-and-provenance change set lands, the orchestrator tags v0.1.0, watches the release workflow, runs gh attestation verify on an archive and records the Evidence; picked by the owner
